say:1:1130528001:1.text: Yes, Darwin fell gravely ill when we were forced to work in the Crimson Highlands. The overseer didn't care whether he lived or died.
say:1:1130528001:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们在深红高原被逼着干活的时候，达文生了重病，监...

say:1:1130528001:1.female: Yes, Darwin fell gravely ill when we were forced to work in the Crimson Highlands. The overseer didn't care whether he lived or died.

say:2:1130528002:1.text: If you hadn't turned up we probably never would have made it back to the boss.
say:2:1130528002:1.source_cn: 要不是您及时出现，我们恐怕就没法回来找皮特老板了。
